entry.idea: Dexory sends autonomous robots to scan warehouse shelves and builds a live digital copy of the warehouse, so managers always know exactly what stock they have and where.
entry.lesson: Solve a boring, repetitive task, like counting stock, with a robot built specifically for the size and shape of the problem.

market.reason: Warehouses across logistics, manufacturing, retail and pharma worldwide need accurate, real-time inventory tracking.

tech.reason: Building the tallest autonomous scanning robot of its kind alongside a live digital twin platform is hard robotics and software engineering.

entry.twist: Its robot is the tallest of its kind in the world at 16 metres, letting it scan very high warehouse racking that other systems cannot reach.
entry.who_pays: Logistics companies, manufacturers, and retail and pharmaceutical businesses pay to use the robots and inventory software in their warehouses.
entry.why_now: Supply chains need real-time inventory accuracy, and warehouses are under pressure to run efficiently with fewer staff doing manual stock checks.
